scope: Reusable analytical methods for Nepal technology businesses; not measured facts about Nepal or claims that these methods guarantee outcomes.
anchor_limit: TU sources establish relevant subject coverage. They are not presented as proof that every named method below appears in a particular syllabus edition.

methods.name: Unit of analysis and classification
methods.nepal_application: Separate persons, households, establishments, registered companies, schools, local governments, accounts and transactions; use the source's NSIC/HS or institutional classification.
methods.failure_to_avoid: Calling wallet accounts unique customers, or registered establishments active ICT buyers.

methods.name: Geographic crosswalk and representativeness
methods.nepal_application: Join country, province, district, municipality and ward records only with verified identifiers and effective boundaries.
methods.failure_to_avoid: Assigning a national or provincial sample estimate to every municipality.

methods.name: Comparable denominators
methods.nepal_application: Use matching age ranges, geography, periods and units when computing device access, payment use, firm density or employment rates.
methods.failure_to_avoid: Dividing an account count by population and describing it as unique-person adoption.

methods.name: Reference period and revision control
methods.nepal_application: Retain fiscal year, survey year, publication date, BS/AD calendar and whether a series is provisional or revised.
methods.failure_to_avoid: Treating a current webpage date as the year of the underlying measurement.

methods.name: Sampling uncertainty and weighting
methods.nepal_application: Use survey weights and design variables where required; report uncertainty and do not extrapolate a small convenience sample as Nepal-wide demand.
methods.failure_to_avoid: A precisely written estimate from a biased or nonrepresentative sample.

methods.name: Causal claims versus association
methods.nepal_application: Evaluate whether digital adoption caused an outcome or merely coincided with income, urbanization, grants, school size or other differences.
methods.failure_to_avoid: Attributing all sales or educational improvement to one technology deployment.

methods.name: Serviceable market estimation
methods.nepal_application: Build bottom-up addressable and reachable ICT markets from verified institution counts, need, eligibility, budgets, access and support reach.
methods.failure_to_avoid: Equating total population, a policy target or all local governments with immediate paying customers.

methods.name: Segmentation and buying committee
methods.nepal_application: Separate public institutions, private schools, health providers, SMEs, enterprises and households; map user, technical evaluator, financial approver and authorized buyer.
methods.failure_to_avoid: Using one generic campaign or assumed decision-maker for every institution.

methods.name: Demand validation and customer discovery
methods.nepal_application: Test a clear technology problem with local interviews, observable workarounds, willingness to pay, a small pilot and documented outcomes.
methods.failure_to_avoid: Treating social engagement, an expressed interest or a founder's preference as validated demand.

methods.name: Positioning with supported proof
methods.nepal_application: Connect a Nepal institutional problem to a differentiated delivery/support capability and exact evidence.
methods.failure_to_avoid: Unsupported superlatives, invented client outcomes or brand-level certificates used as model compliance.

methods.name: Channel and funnel measurement
methods.nepal_application: Track exposure, qualified inquiry, site survey, proposal, compliant bid, order, delivery and payment as distinct dated states.
methods.failure_to_avoid: Calling views revenue, drafted bids submitted bids, or submitted bids awards.

methods.name: External environment scan
methods.nepal_application: Link Nepal political/fiscal changes, economic conditions, social/language needs, technology shifts, legal requirements and environmental hazards to a specific ICT business mechanism.
methods.failure_to_avoid: A generic news digest without a technology-business consequence.

methods.name: Strategic trade-offs and capability fit
methods.nepal_application: Choose markets and solution lines using customer value, capability, compliance, geography, support load, working capital and opportunity cost.
methods.failure_to_avoid: Pursuing every tender or product category regardless of ability to deliver and support it.

methods.name: Business model and resource mapping
methods.nepal_application: Describe customer value, payment mechanism, channels, partners, activities, required skills, delivery cost and ongoing support obligations.
methods.failure_to_avoid: A program application or business-model diagram presented as a viable, funded venture.

methods.name: Bounded pilot and learning loop
methods.nepal_application: Run a reversible Nepal pilot with a question, baseline, acceptance evidence, budget/time limit and explicit next decision.
methods.failure_to_avoid: Scaling an unmeasured demonstration or treating a free pilot as paying-client validation.

methods.name: Contribution margin and unit economics
methods.nepal_application: Model actual goods/services revenue against procurement, import, installation, support, warranty and collection costs using client-approved inputs.
methods.failure_to_avoid: Treating markup, gross margin, contribution and net profit as interchangeable.

methods.name: Cash conversion and working capital
methods.nepal_application: Map stock purchase, advances, bid/performance securities, installation, acceptance, receivables and cash collection for Nepal institutional sales.
methods.failure_to_avoid: Profitable-looking orders that cannot be financed through delivery and collection.

methods.name: Scenario and sensitivity analysis
methods.nepal_application: Test exchange-rate changes, freight delay, interest costs, demand conversion, price pressure and payment delay without pretending the scenarios are forecasts.
methods.failure_to_avoid: One precise return estimate built from uncertain inputs.

methods.name: Decision rights and accountability
methods.nepal_application: Assign an owner, decision authority, reviewer, evidence and escalation for sales, procurement, delivery, finance and support work.
methods.failure_to_avoid: Responsibility assigned without the access, authority or resources to perform it.

methods.name: Planning, monitoring and feedback
methods.nepal_application: Use a small number of observable outcome measures with review cadence, leading indicators, exception handling and corrective action.
methods.failure_to_avoid: Activity counts that reward busy work, punish missing data or conceal unresolved failures.

methods.name: Job analysis and structured recruitment
methods.nepal_application: Translate Nepal ICT delivery/support needs into tasks, skills, practical assessment and a transparent selection process.
methods.failure_to_avoid: Inferring competence, suitability or protected personal traits from social profiles or unreliable proxies.

methods.name: Pay and employment compliance reconciliation
methods.nepal_application: Reconcile the employment contract, applicable law/rules, attendance/leave records, approved payroll inputs, tax and social-security requirements.
methods.failure_to_avoid: Using an old online percentage or a portal registration as proof of current payroll compliance.

methods.name: Skills development and fair performance review
methods.nepal_application: Set role-specific observable expectations, provide tools/training, distinguish missing evidence from poor performance and allow explanation/correction.
methods.failure_to_avoid: Automatic consequential employee decisions based on a single activity score.

methods.name: Process mapping, bottlenecks and quality
methods.nepal_application: Map site survey through procurement, installation, acceptance and support; measure waiting time, rework, failure modes and service capacity.
methods.failure_to_avoid: Automating a broken or unowned process without resolving its controls and failure conditions.

methods.name: Requirement-to-evidence traceability
methods.nepal_application: Link every offered requirement to exact-model/configuration evidence and the official tender's operative text/amendments.
methods.failure_to_avoid: Similar-model or brand evidence presented as exact-model compliance.

methods.name: Public spending stage separation
methods.nepal_application: Keep policy intent, budget allocation, grant recommendation, program approval, procurement notice, award, delivery and payment as separate states.
methods.failure_to_avoid: Converting a national allocation or newspaper report into an active municipal tender.

methods.name: IP and license boundary review
methods.nepal_application: Track original ownership, license scope, third-party components, customer permissions and industrial-property status before distributing a product or client skill.
methods.failure_to_avoid: Assuming a public repository, bought product or unregistered brand is unrestricted intellectual property.

methods.name: Evidence triangulation and contradiction log
methods.nepal_application: Use local media as discovery, then compare the procuring office, regulator, manufacturer or original dataset; retain contradictions instead of silently choosing a convenient claim.
methods.failure_to_avoid: A widely repeated story treated as independently confirmed evidence.

methods.name: IT export scope and estimate reconciliation
methods.nepal_application: Distinguish IT firms, freelancers, digitally delivered services, inward receipts and goods trade; reconcile definitions and reference years before comparison.
methods.failure_to_avoid: Comparing a modeled 2022 IT export estimate directly with a current customs goods total.

methods.name: Risk, continuity and support planning
methods.nepal_application: Connect Nepal transport, power, weather, connectivity, supplier concentration, cash flow and staffing risks to prevention, recovery and support obligations.
methods.failure_to_avoid: A generic risk list with no connection to an actual installation, customer or operating process.
